description: This file contains repository functions for managing certification jobs, audit logs, branch-environment mappings, and metadata in an asynchronous SQLAlchemy-based backend. It defines functions for creating, retrieving, updating, and listing various models related to certification processes.

methods.name: None create_audit_log(session: AsyncSession, action: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: Optional[str], actor: Optional[str], details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Creates an audit log entry for a mutating operation.

methods.name: CertificationJob create_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, req: TriggerCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Creates a new certification job and initializes its result rows.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] get_certification_job_by_run_id(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a certification job by its run ID.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] patch_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str, patch: PatchCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Updates mutable fields of a certification job based on provided patch data.

methods.name: List[BranchEnvironmentMapping] list_mappings(session: AsyncSession, provider: Optional[str] = None, project_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists branch-environment mappings with optional filtering by provider and project_id.

methods.name: BranchEnvironmentMapping create_mapping(session: AsyncSession, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new branch-environment mapping entry.

methods.name: List[MetadataItem] list_metadata(session: AsyncSession, filters: Dict[str, Optional[str]])
methods.description: Lists metadata items filtered by optional scope, key, provider, project_id, and branch.

methods.name: MetadataItem upsert_metadata(session: AsyncSession, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts or updates a metadata item based on provided payload.
